title: One-Bowl Banana Bread
description: A moist, deeply banana-y loaf that's the best use for spotty bananas.

items: 1/2 cup chopped walnuts or chocolate chips (optional)
Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C) and grease a 9x5-inch loaf pan.
Mash the bananas in a large bowl, then stir in the melted butter.
Mix in the brown sugar, egg and vanilla.
Sprinkle the baking soda and salt over the batter and stir, then fold in the flour (and nuts or chips) until no dry streaks remain.
Pour into the pan and bake 55–65 minutes, until a skewer in the center comes out clean.
Cool in the pan for 10 minutes, then turn out onto a rack.

notes: Tent with foil after 40 minutes if the top browns too fast.
